rows: Sell it once you're out of slots.
Your grenade scales with your weapon damage.
Your cape barrier grows with your max health.
Only if they have a real gun hero: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta, Vyper.
The max health it steals also makes your cape barrier bigger.
Get after Fortitude if needed. Ahead? Skip it until you're dying. Sell Fleetfoot for it.
One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.
A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Mo & Krill's Combo.
Most of their damage is gun and Bullet Resilience isn't enough.
Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Kelvin, Geist.
Most of their damage is gun.
Stuns and silences that stop your ult.

changes: Base = Kieran's in-game Pest Control Rat King. All his core items, order and notes kept; Return Fire added as a must, Close Quarters moved into core, lane box trimmed to survival only.

Return Fire (1600) added in Mid after Cultist Sacrifice: ROUND 5 says it's a must for this style; +10 bullet resist always and the active throws 65% of bullet damage back for 6.5s while you sit in the ult. lockbuilds' top Rat King build (26k views) has it as the last required early item; tracklock lists it in actives. Health goes 4.8k (Enduring Speed, 8.8k souls) to 6.4k after the gun spike.

Close Quarters (800) moved from the lane box into Early (6th): the lane box can only hold survival items, and Point Blank was flagged as 'Upgrade' with no Close Quarters owned. Grenade is 70 per shrapnel +0.6x weapon damage, Close Quarters is +20 weapon power inside 15m where the grenade lands, so it's a real grenade item. It also lands the gun spike earlier: HV + Monster + Close Quarters + Opening Rounds = 3200, Fleetfoot (+1600) = exactly 4.8k gun at 10.4k souls (was 13.6k at Cultist).
Core ends at exactly 12: Glass Cannon sells Fleetfoot (6% weapon damage, weakest gun item at 39k). Core total 39.2k (was 37.6k).

Rich box is T4 only now: dropped Arcane Surge (T2, and Rat King's spirit scaling is poor per lockbuilds annotated build) and Heroic Aura (T3 fire rate, not weapon damage, fights the grenade style). Colossus/Lucky Shot/Refresher each name a sell. Counters box renamed with the standard wording.

Public check: tracklock 64% WR build and lockbuilds official both run HV > Opening Rounds, Monster > Cultist, Sprint > Enduring Speed, Fleetfoot, Ballistic Enchantment, Berserker, Siphon Bullets, Fortitude; lockbuilds official also cores Glass Cannon and Return Fire and buys Witchmail/Colossus late. Nobody runs Point Blank, but it's +50 weapon power at grenade range, so it stays as his pick.
Ability order: Consensus: unlock 1, 3, 2, ult, Grenade T1/T2 (90%+), then Pestments T1/T2, then Grenade max, then ult, with Rat Swarm last. Ours is that path exactly.

Item fit: Glass Cannon → Colossus (core, last 6.4k). Kieran's standing rule is no Glass Cannon on Rat King. Colossus keeps the same price and slot, and it suits a grenade tank: the grenade is 70 per shrapnel +0.6x weapon damage, so Colossus's +15% weapon damage feeds it, and the cape barrier is 15% of max health, so +25% base health makes it bigger. It was in Kieran's in-game Unkillable Rat King Late core. Tracklock lists it under defensives/actives (that page shows no buy rate for it). Fleetfoot's sell note now names Colossus.

Item fit: Lucky Shot (rich) → Witchmail. Lucky Shot only empowers bullets (25% proc, no weapon damage stat), so it does nothing for the grenade, and it's not in any public Rat King list. Witchmail has 22% spirit resist and cuts cooldowns when he takes heavy hits (75+). It's in Kieran's in-game build ('your main tank item into spirit') and tracklock pro buys it 13% late. Colossus left the rich box because it's core now.

Round 8: ult-centred notes fixed after the Oct 5 Rule, Ratannia! nerf (cooldown 130 to 160, T1 no longer -20s, so 110 to 160 with T1; damage reduction 15%, T3 25%; radius 20m). Superior Cooldown 'Ult up for every fight' was false (160s x 0.8 = 128s): now 'Grenade, cape and ult all come back faster'. Return Fire, Berserker, Siphon Bullets, Point Blank and Fleetfoot no longer say 'in the ult'.

Round 8: items kept. Post-nerf lockbuilds builds updated Oct 17 (ANGADXO rank 50 annotated; Lockbuilds 'THE TANKIEST GUNNER') still run HV > Opening Rounds, Monster > Cultist, Extra Health > Fortitude, Enduring Speed, Fleetfoot, Ballistic Enchantment, Berserker, Siphon Bullets, Witchmail, Colossus, Return Fire and Superior Cooldown (ANGADXO: 'cooldown is very good' on the ult). Ballistic Enchantment duration 14s to 20s (Sep 16) is a buff. tracklock Rat King page could not be read.

Round 10: Cultist Sacrifice moved from 14.4k to 8k souls, straight after Opening Rounds, so the gun spike comes first (gun 4.8k at 8k, landing 5.6k; health 4.8k still right after on Enduring Speed, 11.2k, was 8.8k). tracklock.gg pro Rat King (last 30 days to Oct 19, 290 games, after the Oct 5 ult nerf): Cultist 61% and Monster Rounds 92% early, Fortitude 96% mid. Buying it 6k souls sooner gets an extra use or two of the 170% soul camp (270s cooldown) and the +10% weapon damage feeds the grenade (70 per shrapnel + 0.6x weapon damage). The rules put Cultist around 8 min with health straight after.
Round 11: Tank only, no role pivot. Empty 'Lost lane?' box: Cultist Sacrifice before Opening Rounds so you farm back faster (gun 4.8k lands on Cultist at 7.2k). No 6.4k run.

Round 12: Extra Charge replaced by Mystic Expansion on the grenade (same 800 spirit, same spot at 4k souls). Extra Charge only adds charges to abilities that already have them (game files: Scrap Grenade AbilityCharges 0, like Haze's dagger; Rat Swarm 1; the game's own Omnicharge Signet text says non-charged abilities need it to get charges), so 'two grenades in the pocket' never happened - it only gave Rat Swarm, maxed last, a charge. Mystic Expansion makes the grenade blasts 20% wider and upgrades into the Ballistic Enchantment the build already buys (pros: Mystic Expansion 60% mid, Ballistic 72% mid, tracklock last 30 days, 290 games), so Ballistic now costs 2400 instead of 3200. Rapid Recharge removed from Slot locked (it upgraded Extra Charge). Restorative Shot removed from the lane box (it was for trading shots from range; you walk up to them, and Extra Regen already covers a bad lane). Opening Rounds/Close Quarters notes now claim only what the item does (their conditional bonuses are on your gun; the flat +8% feeds the grenade). Counter notes made concrete (who to buy them against). Mystic Expansion merges into Ballistic, so the core was one slot short: Witchmail (Kieran's own in-game core item, 'your main tank item into spirit') moves from the rich box to the last core buy (44.8k). Spikes unchanged: gun 4.8k at 8k, health 4.8k at 11.2k.

Round 13: notes cut to what a player wouldn't know (UPDATE 3), desc is a short style label (UPDATE 4), Counters notes name the right heroes (Spirit Resilience: real spirit-damage heroes, no Haze; Counterspell: a parryable ability). Checked: no Extra Charge (Scrap Grenade has no charges).

Round 14: Opening Rounds and Cultist Sacrifice moved into Early ahead of Close Quarters, so gun 4.8k lands exactly on Cultist at 7.2k (was 5.6k at 8k with Close Quarters first); health 4.8k still 11.2k. Divine Barrier added to rich (Dispel Magic is in Counters, so it must be there); Refresher now sells Opening Rounds (Enduring Speed upgrades to the Slot locked Juggernaut). Dispel note had 'Yamato grapple' (Dispel can't stop it; wiki lists Yamato only from Power Slash T1) - now Knockdown, Slowing Hex, Disarming Hex. Bullet Resilience note claimed Haze/Wraith/Vindicta shred bullet resist (false); Counterspell example now confirmed parryable. HV/Fortitude notes cut to the interaction, Fleetfoot's sell note dropped (Colossus says it), Return Fire's how-to sentence dropped. Lost lane? reorder now moves Cultist 1.6k sooner (5.6k) without delaying gun 4.8k.

Round 15: sells made unique - Fleetfoot was named by both Counters and Colossus, and Opening Rounds by both Colossus' fallback and Refresher. Now Counters sell Fleetfoot, Colossus sells Opening Rounds, Refresher sells Cultist Sacrifice (Kieran's in-game build sells the Monster Rounds line late), Divine Barrier sells Dispel Magic.

Round 17: name now 'Rizuhble's Tanky Rat King' (matches its desc and the other tank builds' wording). Rich sell notes use 'for this' (Refresher; Divine Barrier now 'If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.', Dispel being a counter). Items unchanged: the grenade variant was made the ranged grenade-spam build instead, so this stays the close-range tank.

Round 19: style check, no change. Tanky gunner is the only public Rat King style (lockbuilds THE TANKIEST GUNNER official Oct 17, ABL, ANGADXO Oct 17, reezowaka, LIGHTBRINGER; seemeta Oct 5-19). Grenade Spam and Gun Rat King were removed: one invented, one the same style as this build.

Round 20: Late list filled to ~72k: Glass Cannon (official Tankiest Gunner core, Kieran's in-game last buy), Leech, then Refresher as the luxury, then Divine Barrier, each selling the weakest item left.
Round 23: kit check. Royal Pestments' barrier is a % of max health (15%, 25% at T3), so Siphon Bullets' stolen max health also grows the cape; note added. No item changes.
Round 25: points reordered for the tank: Royal Pestments unlocked first with T1 (+4s cape) at L2, Pestments T2 at L7 and T3 (250 damage cap, +10% max-health barrier) before Grenade T3.
